purpose: M3.5 investigation: whether official same-origin endpoints behind these career pages expose deterministic machine-readable vacancy data. Endpoints are read from page source as text and probed with the existing ControlledFetcher policy. No JavaScript is executed, no browser is used, and no vacancy field is extracted from a non-structured response.
constraints: no credentials, cookies or session replay

scope.note: every page the pilot read was scanned for a same-origin content endpoint, so a negative result covers the whole population rather than only the pages a heuristic flagged
